stateful_dataset_exemption.reason: The sovereign RDS control plane persists operational metadata in PostgreSQL 16 through /app/rds/bin/generate-estate and runtime APIs rather than a static SQLite business seed. The production generator deterministically materializes 14,800 primary records across db_instances, wal_archives, db_snapshots, and event_outbox rows inside the compose lab schema. A separate 10k-row relational shadow corpus would not exercise lifecycle fencing, WAL/PITR windows, parameter apply modes, replica promotion, Multi-AZ lease/VIP failover, or transactional outbox semantics that the verifier grades through the public Python entrypoints.

domain_state_model: DBInstance lifecycle status and storage allocation metadata
WAL archive timelines, sequence continuity, and PITR restorable windows
parameter group dynamic vs pending-reboot apply state
replica replication lag, LSN catch-up, and write-lease ownership
Multi-AZ failover leases, health probes, and VIP routing evidence
EventBridge outbox rows, subscription filters, and delivery audit trail
transaction checkpoints and restart-skip recovery state
production_authenticity.reachability_evidence: All graded state is created, mutated, queried, and reported through /app/rds/bin/rdsd, /app/rds/bin/rds-worker, /app/rds/bin/rdsctl, and /app/rds/bin/generate-estate against the PostgreSQL 16 control-plane schema under environment/rds/db/migrations.
